metadata.name: Cazelles Map
metadata.author: Cazelles, B., Courbage, M. & Rabinovich, M.
metadata.description: Discrete-time clipped logistic fast/slow bursting map

extensions.silicon_cosim_note: At I=0.5, I=1.0, and I=2.0 over 30 iterations, hand model and both schemas agree exactly on states and events; Q16.16 RTL reproduces the complete event vectors with maximum state error below 0.0004. The chaotic I=0.05 trace is an explicit excluded boundary.
